name: Starving Arcane
summary: Archmage Modera asks you to clear rogue elementals from the City of Dalaran. The breach has disrupted the city’s enchantments and defenses, and the Kirin Tor needs room to tend its wards.

sections.title: Arcane Fragments
sections.body: The breach has disturbed factotums and enchantments across Dalaran, including those tied to the city’s defenses. Fragmented arcane energy has drawn Seeking Remnants, Saturated Remnants, and Mana Echoes, which seek to fill themselves with its free-flowing magic. Archmage Modera asks you to thin their numbers while the Kirin Tor tends the wards and other incidents.

faq.q: Why are elementals gathering in Dalaran?
faq.answer: Fragmented arcane energy from the breach has drawn rogue elementals seeking to saturate themselves in the free-flowing magic.

faq.q: Who asks me to clear the elementals?
faq.answer: Archmage Modera, who is outside Dalaran, asks you to thin the elemental throng inside the city.
The breach affected factotums and enchantments throughout Dalaran, including some connected to the city’s defenses.
The elemental throng includes Seeking Remnants, Saturated Remnants, and Mana Echoes.
